text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] runtime-prod: ingress queue depth rising (p95 enqueue > 12s, queue-length > 800) — paging oncall: @lina (queueing/backpressure)

lina (oncall): awake. grabbing dashboards. can someone paste grafana + a quick TL;DR of probable cause?

omar (sre): https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/rt/ingress-queues?view=heatmap
TL;DR: sudden spike in enqueue latency past 2:30 UTC, overall qps steady but a subset of long-lived streaming/sync requests dominate worker slots. worker max_inflight saturated; shedding config didn't engage because threshold weight calculation uses `active_streams` not `streaming_sessions`.

tess (runtime): seeing traces like: "enqueue_ms=12500 inflight=320 max_inflight=320 shed=false reason=weight_calc". Looks like streaming sessions are not reducing their weight; bug in the sampling logic. I can patch, but hotfix will take ~30m to test.

lina (oncall): immediate mitigations only. Propose:
1) tighten anonymous + unauthenticated quotas at ingress (per-key & per-IP token-bucket)
2) lower max_inflight to force shedding earlier
3) shorten backend RPC timeouts + enable early-shed flag
4) notify support + status page
Agree?

omar (sre): agree. I'll apply ingress token-bucket for anon keys: 8r/s burst 16 per key, and a per-source-ip soft-cap of 40r/s. Using Kong rate-limiter configmap.

lina (oncall): go ahead and patch. Add `Retry-After` header on 429 responses for anon.

omar (sre): running:
```
kubectl -n prod patch configmap kong-ratelimit --type merge -p '{"data":{"anon_api_generate":"8r/s,burst=16","anon_source_ip":"40r/s,burst=80","anon_retry_after":"5"}}'
```

incident-bot: configmap kong-ratelimit patched by omar at 1865011165. Kong reloaded.

ryan-sdks (devx): heads-up: changing Retry-After will help SDK backoffs. Will push a minor client update note to our SDK repo and add a header parse example.

tess (runtime): starting rolling update to drop `MAX_INFLIGHT` on model-workers from 320 -> 200. Doing 15% pods per minute to avoid losing too much capacity.

tess (runtime): command:
```
kubectl -n prod set env daemonset/model-workers MAX_INFLIGHT=200
kubectl -n prod rollout restart daemonset/model-workers --rolling
```

omar (sre): noticed ingress p95 enqueue drop to ~4s after rate-limits. model-workers that restarted now log `shed=true reason=max_inflight` which is expected. Global p95 trending down.

nina (support): who should I notify? we might surface increased 429s. I can send a short status blurb and ping flagged accounts.

lina (oncall): please notify customers likely impacted: quick check for high-volume api.generate keys. Use the billing/usage dashboard and include note "temporary rate-limits for unauthenticated traffic; paid keys unaffected unless they use anon tokens". Add status page link.

nina (support): sending now. Draft: "We're seeing elevated request queueing. Temporary rate limits on anonymous traffic have been applied which may yield 429s. Engineers are actively mitigating; we'll update in 15 minutes or sooner." Sending to flagged accounts: acme-ads, beta-data-inc, creative-labs.

tess (runtime): also lowering backend RPC idle timeouts from 60s -> 20s to avoid head-of-line blocking from stalled downstreams. Patching vector-store and tokenizer services.

lina (oncall): good. We also need a short-term feature-flag to disable streaming for anon only, in case things don't stabilize.

tess (runtime): feature flag is ready: `ff.streaming.anon=false` in `/deploy/ff/streaming.yaml`. Will wait to flip unless we see p95 > 2s for 10m.

omar (sre): metrics @1865011240: global p50 enqueue 110ms, p95 650ms, p99 1.6s. Anonymous 429 rate increased as expected. Overall QPS down ~22%.

lina (oncall): preparing runbook notes and handoff. My shift ends in 40m. If things hold, leave anon limits for 30m then relax to 15r/s. Handoff to @omar for escalation watch. @tess stay available for runtime patches.

tess (runtime): rolling restart 60% complete. Shedding stable on restarted pods. Will monitor logs for `shed=true` false-negatives.

omar (sre): adding a small header to 429s so SDKs backoff: `Retry-After: 5`. Also adding `x-rw-shed: max_inflight` to dropped responses for observability.

ryan-sdks (devx): acknowledged. I'll add parsing for `x-rw-shed` in the next SDK release note so clients can record metrics.

nina (support): status update posted. Customers acknowledged; one P1 support ticket opened by acme-ads but they look within expected limits.

lina (oncall): runbook snippet (for handoff):
- 1865011165 patched kong-ratelimit CM (anon 8r/s,burst=16; per-ip 40r/s)
- 1865011180 started model-workers MAX_INFLIGHT 320->200 rolling update
- 1865011210 patched backend RPC idle timeouts 60s->20s
- 1865011225 added Retry-After/`x-rw-shed` headers for anon 429s
- support notified impacted customers; anon limits to stay for 30m unless p95 < 500ms for 5m

lina (oncall): leaving thread open. @omar you're the second-watch. escalation criteria: p99 enqueue > 2s for 10m OR error-rate > 0.5% sustained. Tag oncall if either hits.

omar (sre): taking handoff. monitoring dashboards. current: p95 540ms, p99 1.2s. will escalate if regressions.

tess (runtime): I'll continue working on the sampling bug in streaming weights; hope to have testable fix in ~45m. If needed, flip ff.streaming.anon=false.

nina (support): will keep customers updated and reopen if tickets escalate.

incident-bot: thread marked acknowledged by oncall at 1865011370.
